fixes: Capture native document ID, renderer generation, document path and base URL with the pending caret. Reject mismatched, duplicate, stale, destroyed or replaced-state results.
Resolve missing-path fallback by actual unmapped items; duplicate URI/file references no longer suppress the dragging-pasteboard request.
Directory entry metadata and URI trailing slash override image-looking names. Known directories are excluded from the image queue.
Unknown image-looking Finder entries reach both native classification and the existing image queue; native Clipboard silently consumes real drop directories with an empty successful result.
Mixed non-image URI paths are not enqueued as image requests.
File link destinations preserve literal Unicode, percent, hash, parentheses and brackets; a colon in a relative file name is escaped so it cannot become a URI scheme.
Failed native posting releases the pending request and leaves the original browser flow available.
Production pasteboard snapshot provider still chooses drag for drops and general for pastes; injected value fixtures prove the distinction without reading real system boards.

integration.nativeResult: Both document IDs must echo the request. links use absolute local POSIX paths, names and optional isDirectory.
integration.missingPaths: When useDraggingPasteboard is true, native must merge this drag snapshot with explicit paths; never use the general clipboard.

scope.positionLayout: Fixed JSDOM hit-test coordinates; actual CodeMirror edit mapping is verified.

limitations: Native file-open/import/sidebar behavior is owned and verified by file_preferences; this evidence covers renderer routing and native Clipboard directory filtering.
Actual macOS Finder gesture geometry and system drag-board lifetime were not exercised.
